name: SoRT Scope Builder
tagline: Builds SORT Forum remediation scope tables for field stations and copies them straight into Word.
about: A single-page tool used at SORT Forums to click through a station's remediation scope — the questions for its station type, a Property Services table and a site map — and paste the finished tables into Word. The questions live in definitions.json in this repository, which is the source of truth: editors change them in the app and Publish to GitHub. A v2 beta runs beside v1: one flowing page that looks the station up in Flood-Net, saves sessions in the browser and puts the map on the page.

status.summary: v2 is the Scope Builder since 4 Nov 2026 (/SoRT/ opens /SoRT/v2/; v1 kept at /SoRT/v1/): Flood-Net station lookup with corrections of its particulars for the Word tables, ACMA licences, and the radio path to base with fresh fade margins; the map beside the questions (each pane scrolling on its own) with survey marks and the bridges on it (BR1…, each with who manages it and who to call, tabled in Word), its key under the map in the picture; sessions shared with the whole forum by themselves through Flood-Net's server (no Share button; a forum passphrase, no accounts or tokens), an in-page question editor, a Help guide, the local TBM as a desktop task, and follow-ups handed to Flood-Net's teams as tasks, and on the Water Level table a corrosion category for the infrastructure options (OTE’s three AS 4312 groupings, with the standard’s own table shown beside them), suggested from the site’s distance to the sea on QSpatial’s coastline, and an acid sulfate soil flag (Queensland’s soil maps at the site) that asks the contractor for testing. Since 9 Nov 2026: shared sessions save again (Cloudflare's weak version tags had been refusing every save after a read), pictures pasted into a question go into Word and are shared, a long relocation gets a close-up of each end beside the map and in Word, the road reserve draws out to 1:100,000, rainfall tables have no survey marks, 'N to confirm' lists what to check, and the Sessions window is Sessions Management, where a session can be deleted (Delete, then Confirm delete) — from this browser and, if shared, from the forum's shared sessions for everyone. Since 10 Nov 2026: Sessions Management has two tabs with counts (in this browser / saved to the forum) and a tidy-up of the browser's list; the map mends itself when the imagery comes up grey, goes full screen, and takes the current and new orifice run as drawn lines; the Word preview's rows are clickable (each goes to its question); TX power comes from Flood-Net's radio set-up to be checked.
now: v2 at real forums as the default; v1 kept at /SoRT/v1/ in case
next: Playbook: push the five seeded stations once the private repo exists; import more Word reports in batches
Corrosion guide: OTE to confirm that its surf 1–10 km band (C4, where AS 4312 Table 4.1 gives C3) is deliberate; the guide shows both tables and the six bands where OTE is stricter
later: A Dataverse import keyed on v2's permanent question and option codes (v2/playbook/export_tables.mjs writes the tables)

components.name: Scope Builder (v1)
components.what: Version 1, kept as it was at /SoRT/v1/ since the cutover (4 Nov 2026): pick a station type, fill the rows, Copy table for Word; Manage Tables and Table Map edit the definitions in place.

components.name: Definitions (v1)
components.what: Every table, row and option, read from GitHub on start; Publish to GitHub commits edits back, so its history is the audit trail and the rollback.

components.name: Property Services table
components.what: A second table copied into Word under the scope, pre-filled from the scope's coordinates and relocation answer, with its own editor tab.

components.name: Site Map (v1)
components.what: A modal map of the table's pins over Queensland Government imagery, LiDAR contours, the road reserve and rail, with pin write-back and a picture captured for Word.

components.name: Scope Builder v2 (beta)
components.what: One flowing page — forum, station, map, questions, Property Services, follow-ups, preview and Copy for Word — with answers saved in the browser as sessions.

components.name: v2 question bank
components.what: One question bank with permanent codes, four station-type templates, and conditions and follow-up rules as data; checked by the page and by a Node tool before use.

components.name: Flood-Net station lookup
components.what: Searches Flood-Net's read-only API and pre-fills name, number, ALERT IDs, frequency, current comms, repeater details and ACMA licences, marked until confirmed.

components.name: v2 map
components.what: The map on the page: QLD imagery, contours, road reserve and rail; survey marks from the State's control register and bridges from TMR and QLD Roads and Tracks; Flood-Net stations within 3 km.

components.name: Browser tests
components.what: Playwright regression tests that drive the real v1 page in headless Chromium: map framing, pin write-back, Word geometry, GitHub publishing.

components.name: Retired Supabase store
components.what: The last dump of the old definitions database and the script that rebuilds definitions.json from it, kept for the record.

components.name: Playbook (v2)
components.what: Every session shared with the forum through Flood-Net's server (the forum passphrase, once per computer): shared by itself a few seconds after a change, listed and searched in Sessions Management, Open / Start from it / Use as a precedent / Delete (confirmed first; a deleted session is noted in its station's file so no computer shares it back by itself) (orange until checked, then green), and a warning when a station already has sessions. The private repo cdomotor-g/SoRT-playbook holds the five stations it was seeded with.

components.name: Edit questions (v2)
components.what: Quick changes to the questions mid-forum: a draft in the browser until Publish to GitHub commits v2/definitions.json.

components.name: Tasks for Flood-Net (v2)
components.what: Follow-ups and the forum's own tasks, handed to Flood-Net's Tasks tab for a person who may hand out tasks to check and create.

provides.name: QLD Globe map layer recipes
provides.what: Which Queensland Government ArcGIS services and sublayers draw imagery, LiDAR contours (resolved by name), the road reserve, rail and survey marks, and how they are styled. Flood-Net's contour and survey-mark layers were ported from it.

provides.name: Task hand-off to Flood-Net
provides.what: Opens https://floodwarning.net/#tasks=<base64url UTF-8 JSON> with {v:1, source:'sort', session, forum, station:{id, number, name, hub}, tasks:[{ref, title, detail, team:{hub}|{name}, due?}]}; Flood-Net reviews them and files each as source_ref sort:<session>:<ref>.

provides.name: Corrosion categories (AS 4312 and OTE's instruction)
provides.what: AS 4312:2019 Table 4.1 by distance and kind of shore, OTE's three categories for a station's tower, enclosure and orifice run with their distances (guides.corrosion in v2/definitions.json), and Queensland's ocean-facing surf beaches (v2/data/surf-coast.json, made from QSpatial's coastline by v2/tools/build-surf-coast.mjs). Flood-Net's Site exposure carries a copy.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's public read-only agent API: station search and stations near a point, each station's dossier and record, the ACMA licences at its site, and its radio path to base with the fade margin Flood-Net saved for each hop (the dossier's radio_path section).
consumes.on_change: Read the new docs/api-changelog.json entries; if a route or field SoRT reads changed, update v2/js/floodnet.js, bump v2's ?v= stamp and look up a station on /SoRT/v2/.

consumes.what: The Bureau's benchmarks (HDB's Benchmark Details), editors only in Flood-Net: the Local TBM question opens floodwarning.net/#benchmarks-for-sort=<base64url {v:1, source:'sort', nonce, station}>, a signed-in editor presses Send to SoRT, and Flood-Net posts {type:'floodnet:benchmarks', v:1, nonce, station, printed_on, benchmarks[]} to this origin alone (or Copy for SoRT text for Paste from Flood-Net). Read by v2/js/benchmarks.js.
consumes.on_change: Read Flood-Net's sort-benchmarks.js and its atlas entry; if the request or the message changed, update v2/js/benchmarks.js (clean() and request()) and the e2e 'bureau' stand-in, bump v2's ?v= stamp.

consumes.what: The shared sessions: Flood-Net's Worker keeps SoRT's index.json and stations/<key>.json (ETags, If-Match / If-None-Match) at floodwarning.net/api/sort/v1 for whoever sends the forum passphrase (X-SoRT-Passphrase), typed once per computer. Read and written by v2/js/store-remote.js and v2/js/playbook.js.
consumes.on_change: Read Flood-Net's docs/sort-store.md; if a route, status, header or the passphrase check changed, update v2/js/store-remote.js and the e2e fakeStore, bump v2's ?v= stamp.

consumes.what: How Flood-Net's Site exposure reads Queensland's acid sulfate soil maps — the layers (1:25 000, 1:50 000 and 1:100 000 maps, the national atlas, the sample sites), the finest that says something first, and its reading of the map codes' words (assLevel) — ported into v2/js/soil.js for the Acid sulfate soil question.
consumes.on_change: If site-exposure.js changed how it reads the acid sulfate soil maps (its layers, ASS_ORDER or assLevel), bring v2/js/soil.js into step and run node v2/tests/e2e.cjs soil; then move this pin.

consumes.what: How Flood-Net's Road & bridge owners works out who manages a bridge — TMR's register of State-controlled bridges merged with Queensland Roads and Tracks' bridges, a bridge not on the register going with the road it carries (Roads and Tracks' road_owner and scr_indicator, in Flood-Net's owner classes), and who to call from QLDTraffic's road lookup — ported into v2/js/map.js for the bridges on the map (BR1…) and the Word bridges table.
consumes.on_change: If map-road-owners.js changed its bridge sources, its owner classes (OWNER_CODE, classOf) or the road lookup (LOOKUP_URL, digestContacts, pickContact), bring v2/js/map.js's bridges into step and run node v2/tests/e2e.cjs map; then move this pin.
